acceptance_predicates.description: A forward upgrade acquires one durable barrier before quiescence and binds its immutable session identity.
The same barrier identity is reread under the ordered scope before each later lifecycle admission.
Reopen durably transitions the forward barrier through releasing and released only after terminal validation.
Process death, stale identity, failed recheck, and uncertain release remain rejection or ambiguity without mutation.

definition_of_done: Exact hostile tests cover acquire, recheck, releasing, released, process-death, and uncertain-reopen paths.
Independent review and hosted quality/formal checks pass for one exact product revision.
Public apply, rollback, release, and Dispatch remain rejection-only; the formal model remains best-effort guidance.

inputs.description: Existing durable barrier session and ordered lock contracts.

outputs.description: A separately reviewable acquire/recheck/reopen lifecycle contract and hostile evidence.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before merge.
No public mutation path is enabled by this AR.
